entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse thing. I need a return label right now. This is ridiculous.
I can certainly look into a return for you. To get started, could I please have your name and order number?
The name is Mike Schmidt, order number 8-6-7-5-3-0-9. Just hurry up, I don't have all day for this.

Thank you, Mike. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 30th, which was 19 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
There's no 'issue' with it! I just changed my mind, okay? It was an impulse buy, I thought I'd be some fitness guru, and I just don't use it. It's been sitting in its box. I want my money back.
Okay, I understand. So you're looking to return it because it wasn't the right fit for your routine. Let me just review the return eligibility for you. Please hold one moment.

You'd better. I'm not playing games. If I don't get a full refund, I'll be speaking to your manager and leaving a review on every website I can find. I'm not getting stuck with some item I have to try and resale online.
Thank you for your patience, Mike. I've checked our policy, and it states here that all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery, as long as they are in original condition.

Since you received the band 19 days ago, you're well within that timeframe. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label to send to the email address on file right now.
Oh. Okay. Well, good. That's what should have happened from the start. Finally, some simple customer service. So the label is coming to my email?

Yes, it should be in your inbox within the next few minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive the item back, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's it. Just make sure that email shows up.
It's on its way. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
